title: Concept: Conan source download cache left empty
description: global.conf declares an empty `download_cache` that re-fetches sources every time, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Without a recorded digest the downloaded artifact cannot be checked against what was reviewed, so substitution is undetectable at install time. This rule reads an empty `download_cache` that re-fetches sources every time.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through global.conf (conan).
risk: Without a recorded digest the downloaded artifact cannot be checked against what was reviewed, so substitution is undetectable at install time. This rule reads an empty `download_cache` that re-fetches sources every time.
